model_choice_reason: User-authorized bounded React component and product UI implementation with preserved transport/native contracts

design_contract.read: A focused research workbench for people directing research and reviewing results; calm, precise, clear hierarchy and restrained motion. Actual product UI, not marketing landing page.
design_contract.layout: Desktop unified project/function navigation on left, current research/session/conversation in center, contextual workspace/files/results inspector on right or drawer. At smaller widths collapse navigation/inspector without hiding current task or status. Project list/first use/auth/pairing/settings and detail pages share shell vocabulary.
design_contract.priority: Current project, current work, next valid action, and results. Move lengthy optional setup/qualification/coding sections into labelled accessible disclosure or workspace panel. Any blocking state and explicit confirmation must remain visible/available. No new permission or backend bypass.
design_contract.visual: Keep established semantic token values and light/dark support; app-level supplementary tokens may improve surface hierarchy but immutable spec tokens remain unchanged and legacy base token contract still passes. System Chinese/Segoe UI fonts, readable 14-16px base, limited borders/subtle elevation, coherent 4px spacing, crisp blue accent, generous main canvas and compact side metadata. No fake metrics, decorative marketing hero, random gradients, or external font/network dependency.
design_contract.motion: Short purposeful 120-180ms transitions; respect reduced motion. Keyboard focus visible; responsive at320/768/1024/1440.
design_contract.structure: Reusable UI primitives and AppShell; navigation module removes main/screens circular dependency; presentational Workbench layout components accept state/actions while existing command/protocol logic remains in controllers. No Redux/new state library/new React install; already React19.3/Vite8.3.1.
